name: Variation Gallery for WooCommerce
author: TaskPlugins

sections.description:
The Variation Gallery for WooCommerce variation products allows multiple images per variation to add an additional variable product gallery.

variation gallery settings

Navigate to WP Admin >> tools >> Variation Gallery. These settings override all individual variable products that have Variation Gallery settings when the override product settings are enabled. You can set the gallery thumbnail position.

Variation Gallery with Product

Navigate to WP Admin >> Products. To select, add a new product, or modify an existing product, click on the product name or edit button. It is mandatory to select “Variable Product” from the product data dropdown.

To navigate to the variations tab in a variable product. To generate variations, the button can generate existing attributes created from the attribute tab or add variations manually one by one as per your requirement. When a variation accordion box is created, click to add product information or modify it.

To open a variation accordion box. The main image for each product variation box is automatically displayed as a gallery image on the single product page.

Each variation accordion box has a Add Variation Images button. To click the add variation images button to add the selected image, it will then be displayed in the single product gallery images when it selects a variation. After adding or editing information, click to save changes.

To navigate to the Variation Gallery tab in a variable product. The product settings will apply to individual products, not every product, if override product settings are not enabled. The override product settings are available on the tools menu under the Variation gallery. You can select a setting as per your need. Once you have made your changes, click the Save Changes button.

How to showcase variation images to customers

Navigate to Product Shop >> Single Product. The variable product gallery when it selects an attribute of the product page. Then it will display variation images with a slider.

Compatibility

Variation Gallery for Woocommerce plugin is integrated into WooCommerce and WordPress, but only where necessary. It’s unlikely to conflict with other plugins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the variation gallery for woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate tools >> variation gallery to set the variation gallery settings.
  4. Go to WooCommerce product to add new products.
